_comment: Step 16 (advisor, digest length): the main topics bar is 7 (topic_bar), custom topics keep 6 (custom_topic_bar). Step 15 (off means off): a story never reaches a reader who switched its main topic off (one of the six main topics); otherwise it needs one tag the reader has on. Step 8: a story is in a digest if final_score >= editorial_bar, or its main topic is followed and its topic_score >= topic_bar (topic_needs_boost: and above its final_score; the editor's boost is capped per topic by topic_boost_max); no fixed count, no topic cap; lowest-ranked stories are cut until the ONE message fits message_char_limit (below Telegram's fold). Digest settings shared by the Worker cron, worker/scripts/digest-cli.mjs and job/dupes.py (one place, same behaviour). Edit here, then redeploy the Worker. Scores: the editor's final_score (job/editor.py); a story the editor has not scored uses its first-pass importance minus unedited_offset.
